A standalone high-precision checker passed 336 finite corroborative tests. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The logarithmic boundary character is a canonical Mellin-frequency rough symbol; unlike regular-symbol trace-class semicommutators its product defect is noncompact. Subtraction of exactly one forced scalar produces a positive operator with a sharp all-dimensional weak-Schatten threshold and coefficient. This provides a structurally motivated counterpoint to smooth trace formulas and quantifies the obstruction rather than merely calculating a known moment.
